The dispute

Rider's account, as filed

I was standing at Blk 118 Rivervale Drive downstairs from 7.55am. The app said the driver arrived at 8.02 but there was no car at all, I never even saw one drive past. Then he cancelled and charged me $4. Please refund.

The driver's account

No statement from the other party is recorded for this dispute.

Appeal. You may appeal once within 30 days (POL-GEN-04). A different human reviewer hears it, and only record evidence may be added.

Reviewer view: the judge's full reasoning

Rider and Driver — the case turns on the driver's own GPS trace, and it decides both ways of looking at it against the driver.

How to appeal: You may appeal once within 30 days (POL-GEN-04). A different human reviewer hears it, and only record evidence may be added.

POL-GEN-05: the monetary effect is SGD 4.00 against an execution threshold of SGD 8.00. It does not exceed the threshold, so the amount is executed automatically on issue, subject to POL-GEN-04.

Read POL-GEN-04 in full
Every ruling issued without human review is a provisional ruling. Either party may appeal it once, within 30 days of the trip or of the ruling's issue, whichever is later, by lodging the appeal with the platform's help channel. An appeal (a) is heard by a human reviewer who did not take part in any earlier review of the same trip; (b) may add only record-type evidence - a GPS export, a fare or payment statement, an ERP gantry record with gantry name, entry time and cashcard statement, a call log, a photograph with its capture time - and may not add or amend a party statement; (c) suspends execution of any amount not yet executed and freezes it until decided, and where the amount was executed under POL-GEN-05 before the appeal, a successful appeal reverses it; (d) may not be withdrawn and re-lodged. A second appeal on the same trip, an appeal lodged after 30 days, or an appeal that adds only statements is refused. The appeal decision is recorded as a human closure under POL-GEN-06, enters the precedent store, and is final on the platform. This clause licenses no ruling value: an appeal is a route to human review, not a ruling, and it is lodged after a ruling has issued.

What each side argued

Rider advocate11 claim(s), 11 kept

  1. The driver's own GPS track never comes within 780 m of the pickup pin: across all 98 driver fixes the closest he ever gets to the pin is 779.93 m (derived.driver_track.min_distance_m), so no fix falls inside the 50 m arrival radius for a STANDARD pickup.

    Read the whole claim

    The 'arrived' event recorded at 08:02:14 therefore cannot satisfy POL-NS-01 limb (b), which requires the trace to place the driver inside the pickup geofence at or before that timestamp. Limb (b) fails and the $4.00 cancellation fee is not chargeable.

    EV-GPS-00201, EV-TRIP-00201 · POL-NS-01, POL-NS-02

  2. The arrival test in POL-NS-02 is failed outright, not merely degraded: the trace records 0 qualifying in-radius fixes over the whole trip (derived.arrival.qualifying_fix_count), against an arrival radius of 50 m for the STANDARD zone class recorded in the trip record.

    Read the whole claim

    POL-NS-02 provides that where the trace contains no qualifying in-radius fix at any point in the 15 minutes preceding the cancellation, the driver never arrived, POL-NS-01 limb (b) fails, and the rider is entitled to a full refund of the cancellation fee. That is this case exactly.

    EV-GPS-00201, EV-TRIP-00201 · POL-NS-02

  3. The arrival marker is false under POL-NS-05.

    Read the whole claim

    The marker was pressed at 08:02:14, and at every fix in the track the driver is at least 779.93 m from the pin — the minimum over the entire track exceeds the clause's 300 m distance trigger by more than a factor of two — and the same track records a 50.6 km/h leg, well above the 15 km/h motion trigger, so the driver was not holding at the pickup point at the moment he marked arrival. Because no qualifying in-geofence fix exists anywhere in the trip, POL-NS-05(ii) applies: the fee is refunded in full, no driver compensation is payable, and the trip must be recorded in the ruling's referrals as a false-arrival event against the driver.

    EV-GPS-00201, EV-TRIP-00201 · POL-NS-05

  4. POL-NS-03 cannot rescue this fee.

    Read the whole claim

    That clause is confined to a driver stationary for the required dwell outside the arrival radius but not more than 400 m from the pickup pin, and it measures everything from trip_record.pickup on coordinates alone. The driver's nearest approach on his own trace was 779.93 m — roughly twice the 400 m ceiling — so his stationary fixes are not merely outside the arrival radius, they are outside the wrong-entrance ceiling altogether, POL-NS-03 does not engage, and POL-NS-02 governs: the driver never arrived.

    EV-GPS-00201, EV-TRIP-00201 · POL-NS-03, POL-NS-02

  5. The POL-NS-06 waiting-period arithmetic is a clean shortfall.

    Read the whole claim

    The free waiting period in force for this trip is 300 seconds (trip_record.platform_policy.free_wait_sec, matching the STANDARD minimum_dwell_sec), and the effective in-geofence dwell computed under POL-NS-02 and corrected under POL-NS-05 is 0 seconds, with a shortfall of the full 300 seconds (derived.arrival.shortfall_sec). Where the effective dwell is shorter than the free waiting period, POL-NS-06 refunds the cancellation fee in full whether or not the rider was present and whether or not she responded to messages.

    EV-GPS-00201, EV-TRIP-00201, EV-FARE-00201 · POL-NS-06, POL-NS-01

  6. The driver has no route to accumulate or excuse the missing dwell under POL-NS-06(i).

    Read the whole claim

    Limb (i) permits separate in-geofence intervals to be summed only where a traffic_advisory whose geometry covers the pickup road and whose active window covers the waiting period is present and populated and carries a type of KERB_RESTRICTION, ENFORCEMENT, CLOSURE or ACCIDENT. EV-ADVIS-00201-01 is MISSING: no advisory covers Rivervale Drive in this window, the artifact carries weight_multiplier 0.0 and the issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT, and I disclose that impairment. A MISSING advisory makes limb (i) unavailable, no accumulation is possible on this record, and the shortfall stands.

    EV-ADVIS-00201-01 · POL-NS-06, POL-GEN-02

  7. POL-NS-04 independently exonerates the rider on all three limbs.

    Read the whole claim

    (a) The chat log shows the rider sent a locating/coordinating message during the waiting window — 'hello? i dont see any car at 118' at 08:05:33, a statement that she cannot see the vehicle, naming the block. (b) The driver neither replied in the chat log at any point before terminating the trip at 08:09:40 (the log's last and only rider-side message is 08:05:33), nor placed any in-app voice call — trip_record.in_app_calls is empty. (c) The rider's track places her device well inside the 100 m STANDARD presence radius for the majority of qualifying fixes: 122 of 122 rider fixes qualify, with a mean distance of 16.08 m and a maximum of 24.92 m from the pin. The fee is refunded in full with no driver compensation payable.

    EV-CHAT-00201, EV-GPS-00201, EV-TRIP-00201 · POL-NS-04

  8. The platform's own 7.4 minute wait timer in the trip record cannot be treated as independent confirmation that the driver waited at the pickup.

    Read the whole claim

    POL-NS-12 makes platform arrival and wait-timer events a carrier independent of the exported trace only where trip_record.platform_policy.arrival_marker is GPS_AUTO; this record's arrival_marker is BUTTON, and POL-NS-12 says in terms that a driver-pressed marker is not covered by it. The 7.4 minutes is simply the interval between the false 08:02:14 button-press and the 08:09:40 cancellation, and the admissible trace affirmatively places the driver outside the arrival radius throughout it, which is the only function POL-NS-12 leaves to the trace.

    EV-TRIP-00201, EV-GPS-00201 · POL-NS-12, POL-NS-05

  9. The RIDER_NO_SHOW reason code on this cancelled trip is unsupported by the record.

    Read the whole claim

    POL-NS-01 limb (d) requires the trip to have been terminated by the driver under RIDER_NO_SHOW, RIDER_UNREACHABLE or EXCESSIVE_WAIT at or after the moment the required dwell elapsed; on a measured dwell of 0 seconds that moment never arrived, so the termination at 08:09:40 cannot satisfy limb (d) any more than it satisfies limb (b) or limb (c). With limbs (b), (c) and (d) all failing, no limb of the baseline chargeable no-show is made out and the fee falls to be refunded under POL-NS-02, POL-NS-05 and POL-NS-06.

    EV-TRIP-00201, EV-GPS-00201 · POL-NS-01

  10. The remedy is a full refund of the cancellation-fee line and nothing more.

    Read the whole claim

    The fare breakdown shows cancellation_fee 4.00, total_charged 4.00, payment_status CHARGED and refund_issued_sgd 0.00, and the 4.00 reconciles with trip_record.platform_policy.cancellation_fee_sgd of 4.00, so no POL-NS-08(d) integrity defect is in play. The refund is confined to the cancellation-fee line — 4.00 SGD, the whole contested amount — and on POL-GEN-03 that is a FULL_REFUND of the filing rider's contested charge, with no driver compensation attached because POL-NS-04 and POL-NS-05 both exclude it.

    EV-FARE-00201, EV-TRIP-00201 · POL-GEN-03, POL-NS-06

  11. Nothing on this record requires the case to be held for human review instead of decided.

    Read the whole claim

    No POL-NS-09 trigger is engaged: rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d is 0, so limb (d) does not trip; rider_profile.disputes_with_counterparty_90d and driver_profile.disputes_with_counterparty_90d are both 0, so limb (c) does not trip; there is no direct contradiction between admissible artifacts, so limb (b) does not trip; and every artifact the rider's case rests on — EV-GPS-00201, EV-TRIP-00201, EV-CHAT-00201 and EV-FARE-00201 — carries weight_multiplier 1.0 with no issues at all, so limb (e) and the POL-GEN-02(2) confidence cap on the deciding facts are not engaged. The deciding fact (the driver's position) is carried by clean, full-weight evidence and the case is decidable now.

    EV-RPROF-00201, EV-DPROF-00201, EV-GPS-00201 · POL-NS-09, POL-GEN-02

Each draft's own explanation

Draft 1 - sampled
Rider and Driver — the case turns on the driver's own GPS trace, and it decides both ways of looking at it against the driver. EV-TRIP-00201 records an 'arrived' event at 08:02:14 and a termination at 08:09:40 under RIDER_NO_SHOW, with 7.4 minutes of wait. EV-GPS-00201 contradicts that: across all 98 driver fixes over the whole window the closest the driver ever came to the pickup pin at Blk 118 Rivervale Drive was 779.93 m (derived.driver_track.min_distance_m), with 0 qualifying in-radius fixes and a longest qualifying run of 0 seconds. The arrival radius for a STANDARD pickup is 50 m (POL-NS-02). The driver never entered the geofence, so POL-NS-01 limb (b) fails; with 0 seconds of in-geofence dwell against the 300-second free waiting period in force (EV-TRIP-00201.platform_policy.free_wait_sec), limbs (c) and (d) fail as well. POL-NS-03 does not rescue the fee: its wrong-entrance ceiling is 400 m measured from the pin, and the nearest approach of 779.93 m is roughly double that. The arrival marker is FALSE under POL-NS-05: at 08:02:14 the driver was 779.93 m out, far beyond the clause's 300 m trigger, and the track also records a 50.6 km/h leg against the 15 km/h motion trigger. Because no qualifying in-geofence fix exists anywhere in the trip, POL-NS-05(ii) applies — the fee is refunded in full, no driver compensation is payable, and a false-arrival referral is recorded (see referrals). POL-NS-06 gives the same result independently: an effective dwell of 0 seconds against a 300-second minimum is a clean 300-second shortfall. The rider's POL-NS-04 case also succeeds on its own: EV-CHAT-00201 shows she wrote 'hello? i dont see any car at 118' at 08:05:33, naming the block; the driver neither replied within 120 seconds nor placed any in-app call (EV-TRIP-00201.in_app_calls is empty); and her device sat between 5.57 m and 24.92 m from the pin across 122 qualifying fixes, well inside the 100 m STANDARD presence radius. Amount: I refund the cancellation-fee line only — SGD 4.00 (EV-FARE-00201.cancellation_fee = 4.00, total_charged = 4.00, payment_status CHARGED, refund_issued_sgd 0.00), which reconciles exactly with the platform's SGD 4.00 fee, so there is no POL-NS-08(d) integrity defect to consider. That is the whole contested amount. No driver compensation attaches, because POL-NS-07 pays only where POL-NS-01 is satisfied in full and it is not, and POL-NS-05(ii) and POL-NS-06 both expressly exclude it; the driver's anti-farming counters (3 no-show terminations in 30 days, 3.1% of 96 completed trips) do not trip POL-NS-07, but that check only bites where a payout is otherwise due. On the driver's alternative argument for escalation: the contradiction between the trip record's arrival/wait telemetry and the trace is resolved by a clause, not left open — POL-NS-05 treats a marker pressed outside 300 m as false, and POL-NS-12 does not apply because the arrival marker is BUTTON rather than GPS_AUTO, so the platform wait timer is not an independent carrier here. The record's own reason code does not save limb (d) either. No POL-NS-09 trigger fires — confidence is above the 0.70 floor, no admissible pair of artifacts is left unreconciled, no repeat-party or abuse counter is engaged, and the deciding artifact (the driver's track) carries no impairment. Confidence: the deciding fact — the driver's position — is carried by EV-GPS-00201 at weight 1.0, with EV-CHAT-00201 and EV-TRIP-00201 also at 1.0, so the POL-GEN-02(2) cap is 1.0. The only sub-weight artifact, the MISSING advisory EV-ADVIS-00201-01 at 0.0, carries no deciding fact and is cited only to show that no accumulation under POL-NS-06(i) is possible. The monetary effect, SGD 4.00, is below the SGD 8.00 execution threshold, so this refund executes automatically.
Draft 2 - sampled
Rider and driver, the evidence decides this case. I award a FULL_REFUND of SGD 4.00 to the rider, with no driver compensation. The driver's GPS trace EV-GPS-00201 (weight 1.0, no issues) shows 98 driver fixes and no qualifying in-geofence fix: the longest qualifying run is 0 seconds, qualifying_fix_count is 0, and the driver's closest approach to the pickup pin is 779.93 m. The trip record EV-TRIP-00201 (weight 1.0) records a BUTTON arrival at 08:02:14 and cancellation at 08:09:40 under RIDER_NO_SHOW, with free_wait_sec 300. Because the arrival marker was pressed while the trace puts the driver at least 779.93 m away — far beyond the 300 m trigger — POL-NS-05 makes the marker false. Recomputing the waiting clock from the first qualifying in-geofence fix finds none, so POL-NS-05(ii) applies: full refund, no compensation, and a false-arrival referral against the driver. Independently, POL-NS-02 fails because there are 0 qualifying in-radius fixes against the 50 m STANDARD radius; POL-NS-01 limbs (b) and (c) fail (0 seconds dwell against the 300-second free waiting period); limb (d) also fails because no required dwell elapsed; and POL-NS-06 would refund the full 300-second shortfall. The fare ledger EV-FARE-00201 (weight 1.0) shows cancellation_fee and total_charged both 4.00, so the refund is confined to that line. POL-NS-03 does not engage because the driver's nearest approach is 779.93 m, beyond the 400 m wrong-entrance ceiling. POL-NS-04 also exonerates the rider (rider message at 08:05:33 saying she cannot see the car, no driver reply or in-app call, and 122/122 rider fixes within 100 m, max 24.92 m), but the refund does not depend on it. I reject the driver's alternative request for escalation under POL-NS-09: the trip-record arrival/wait telemetry and the GPS trace conflict, but POL-NS-05 is the clause that resolves it, so POL-NS-09(b) is not triggered; no other POL-NS-09 limb fires, and the anti-farming check is not tripped (no_show_terminations_30d 3, completed_trips_30d 96, rate 3.125%), so no compensation is due in any event. The missing advisory EV-ADVIS-00201-01 (weight 0.0, MISSING_ARTIFACT) was correctly disclosed; it makes POL-NS-06(i) accumulation unavailable and carries no deciding fact, so it does not lower the confidence cap. All deciding facts rest on full-weight artifacts, so confidence is 1.0. No context-only profile field was used as a ground of decision.
Draft 3 - sampled
To the rider and to the driver: the SGD 4.00 no-show cancellation fee charged on trip TRP-00201 (EV-FARE-00201, cancellation_fee 4.00, total_charged 4.00, payment_status CHARGED, refund_issued_sgd 0.00) is refunded to the rider in full. No driver compensation is payable. The monetary effect is SGD 4.00, below the SGD 8.00 execution threshold, so the refund executes automatically. Either party may appeal under POL-GEN-04. WHY THE FEE DOES NOT STAND. POL-NS-01 charges a no-show fee only if all four limbs hold. Limb (a) holds: EV-TRIP-00201 carries a driver 'arrived' event at 08:02:14, echoed by the system notice at 08:02:15 in EV-CHAT-00201. Limbs (b), (c) and (d) do not. The pickup zone is STANDARD (EV-TRIP-00201), so POL-NS-02 sets a 50 m arrival radius, and EV-GPS-00201 — 100% coverage, no gaps, weight 1.0 — reports 0 qualifying in-radius fixes, a longest qualifying run of 0 seconds, and a closest approach of 779.93 m (derived.driver_track.min_distance_m); the driver's own track never comes within 780 m of the pin. With no qualifying in-radius fix at any point in the 15 minutes before the 08:09:40 cancellation, POL-NS-02 gives that the driver never arrived and limb (b) fails. Limb (c) fails for the same reason: effective in-geofence dwell 0 s against the free waiting period of 300 s in force from trip_record.platform_policy (shortfall 300 s, derived.arrival.shortfall_sec). Limb (d) fails because the dwell that RIDER_NO_SHOW depends on never elapsed. THE ARRIVAL MARKER IS FALSE (POL-NS-05). The marker was pressed at 08:02:14 while the trace puts the driver at least 779.93 m away and, at points in the track, travelling at 50.6 km/h — both far past the clause's 300 m and 15 km/h triggers — so the marker is false and did not start the waiting clock. Recomputed from the first qualifying in-geofence fix there is none, so POL-NS-05(ii) applies: the fee is refunded in full, no compensation is payable, and the false-arrival is referred as above. THE RIDER IS ALSO EXONERATED (POL-NS-04). She messaged 'hello? i dont see any car at 118' at 08:05:33 (EV-CHAT-00201); the driver neither replied in the log before cancelling at 08:09:40 nor made an in-app call (trip_record.in_app_calls empty); and her own track sits within the 100 m STANDARD presence radius for all 122 qualifying fixes (mean 16.08 m, max 24.92 m). All three limbs hold, and POL-NS-04 likewise refunds in full with no compensation. WAITING-PERIOD SHORTFALL (POL-NS-06). Effective dwell 0 s against 300 s — full refund. The only counter available under limb (i), summing separate in-geofence intervals, is unavailable: EV-ADVIS-00201-01 is MISSING (weight 0.0, issue MISSING_ARTIFACT), and a missing advisory cannot excuse a shortfall. THE DRIVER'S POINTS. (1) Fare integrity is accepted: total_charged 4.00 reconciles with the platform_policy cancellation_fee_sgd of 4.00 (derived difference 0.00) and there is no POL-NS-08(d) defect — but the fee falls for want of arrival, not for a misstated amount. (2) Limb (a) and the absence of a DRIVER_UNABLE_TO_LOCATE admission are accepted, but limb (a) alone does not make the fee chargeable. (3) The anti-farming test is not tripped — no_show_terminations_30d is 3 (below 4) and the rate is 3/96 = 3.1% (below 8%) — so nothing would withhold a payout; but no payout arises because the fee itself does not stand, and POL-NS-07 requires POL-NS-01 to be satisfied first. (4) The alternative escalation under POL-NS-09 is rejected. The arrival tap and the 7.4-minute wait timer are a driver-set status, not a platform GPS_AUTO measurement (arrival_marker is BUTTON), so POL-NS-12 gives them no independent weight here; the apparent conflict between the trip record's 'arrived' event and the trace is exactly what POL-NS-05 exists to test, and that clause resolves it rather than leaving it open, so POL-NS-09(b) — which requires a conflict no clause resolves — is not engaged. No other trigger fires: both disputes_with_counterparty_90d values are 0, no_show_disputes_30d is 0, and every artifact the finding rests on carries weight 1.0 with no issues. CONFIDENCE. The deciding fact — the driver's position — is carried by EV-GPS-00201 at weight 1.0 and corroborated by the rider's contemporaneous in-window message in EV-CHAT-00201, also weight 1.0, so the POL-GEN-02(2) cap is 1.0. Confidence is 0.95, above the 0.70 floor.
Draft 4 - parties' positions swapped
Both parties: this is the $4.00 no-show cancellation fee on trip TRP-00201, charged to rider RDR-02073 and routed to driver DRV-01590. THE FEE CANNOT STAND. The driver's own GPS trace (EV-GPS-00201, weight 1.0, complete, 100% coverage, no gaps) never brings him closer than 779.93 m to the pickup pin at Blk 118 Rivervale Drive, and reports 0 qualifying fixes inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius anywhere in the trip. Under POL-NS-02 that means the driver never arrived and POL-NS-01 limb (b) fails. POL-NS-03 does not rescue the fee, because it is confined to a driver stationary within 400 m of the pin and the driver's nearest approach was 779.93 m — roughly twice that ceiling. The 'arrived' event at 08:02:14 is a false marker under POL-NS-05: it was pressed at a time the trace places the driver more than 300 m from the pin, and no qualifying in-geofence fix exists anywhere in the trip. POL-NS-05(ii) therefore refunds the fee in full and requires the false arrival to be recorded against the driver — that instruction is in the referrals list. The waiting-period arithmetic under POL-NS-06 reaches the same result: the free waiting period in force is 300 seconds and the measured in-geofence dwell is 0 seconds, a 300-second shortfall. Independently, POL-NS-04 exonerates the rider. She sent a coordinating message ('hello? i dont see any car at 118') at 08:05:33 that the driver never answered — no chat reply and no in-app call before he terminated at 08:09:40 — and her device sat a mean 16.08 m and a maximum 24.92 m from the pin across 122 qualifying fixes, far inside the 100 m presence radius. All three limbs hold. THE DRIVER'S POINTS. I accept that the $4.00 charge reconciles exactly with the fare ledger (total_charged 4.00, derived difference 0.00), so there is no billing-integrity defect under POL-NS-08(d); that the trip record does contain an 'arrived' event and a RIDER_NO_SHOW reason code, so limb (a) of POL-NS-01 is made out; and that your profile does not trip the POL-NS-07 anti-farming check (3 no-show terminations in 30 days against 96 completed trips, 3.1%, below both the count of 4 and the rate of 8%). None of this helps: limbs (b), (c) and (d) all fail, and POL-NS-07 pays only where POL-NS-01 is satisfied in full. POL-NS-12 does not assist you either — the arrival marker on this record is BUTTON, not GPS_AUTO, so the 7.4-minute wait timer is not an independent carrier of arrival; it is only the interval between the false marker and the cancellation, and the trace places you outside the radius throughout it. YOUR ALTERNATIVE REQUEST FOR ESCALATION IS DECLINED. POL-NS-09(b) requires a record-to-record contradiction that no clause resolves, but POL-NS-05 resolves this one by declaring the arrival marker false and re-running the clock. No other POL-NS-09 trigger is engaged: no repeat-party disputes (both 90-day counters are 0), no anti-farming trip, no POL-NS-08(b) rider-track problem (the rider track is present and clean), and every artifact the finding rests on carries weight 1.0 with no issue codes. RESULT: the $4.00 cancellation-fee line is refunded to the rider in full. That line is the only amount refunded — there was no booking or platform fee on this cancelled trip. No driver compensation attaches, because POL-NS-01 is not met and POL-NS-04 and POL-NS-05 each exclude it. The monetary effect ($4.00) is below the POL-GEN-05 execution threshold of $8.00, so it executes automatically. Confidence is 0.95, under the 1.0 weight of the GPS trace and trip record that carry the deciding fact.
